text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: The island whale has sunk! We defeated it... right? We did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
島クジラが沈んだわ！
倒せた……
のよね？　
やったわー！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Please wait. It's pretending to sink, but it will resurface from somewhere. That's its strategy... Last time, Tamaki and the others almost fell for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちください。
沈んだと見せかけて、
どこからかまた浮上するのが
あいつの策略ですわ……
前回も、タマキさんたちが
その術中にハマりかけましたの。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Ah! There it is! Over there! It quietly surfaced without attracting attention!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
出たわ！　
あそこ！
目立たないようにそーっと浮上したー！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: It's planning to ambush us. It's so sneaky for such a big thing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
奇襲をかけるつもりですね。
大きい割に
やり方が姑息……

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Let's go! We'll fight it thoroughly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
参りましょう！
徹底的に戦いますわよ！
